subject: MFA keeps failing after phone reset
body: Reset my phone last week; authenticator codes no longer work.
resolution: Walked user through MFA re-enrolment; cleared stale session cookies.

subject: Locked out after travel
body: Travelled abroad and now every login attempt loops back to MFA.
resolution: Synced device clock; issue resolved without admin reset.

subject: Cannot access dashboard
body: Password works but MFA step fails three times then returns to login.
resolution: Replay protection triggered by double-submit; advised single click on Verify.

subject: Refund not received
body: Cancelled plan but charge posted again on May 1.
resolution: Billing cycle lag; issued prorated refund.

subject: PDF export stuck
body: Large report export hangs around halfway.
resolution: Suggested CSV export for >1000 rows; engineering ticket opened.
